newsitem.title: USA: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nuke back after brief outage.
newsitem.headline: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nuke back after brief outage.

text.p: The 1,205 megawatt Perry nuclear power plant in North Perry, Ohio, was operating at near 25 percent of capacity early Wednesday following a brief shutdown for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"The operators took the plant down last night (Tuesday) to repair a one-inch steam drain line off the turbine," Jim Sielicki, spokesman for plant operator Centerior Energy Corp, said Wednesday.
Following the repair, the plant resumed contributions to the electricity grid at 742 EST Wednesday, Sielicki said.
The company was boosting power output and expected the plant to reach full production Thursday afternoon, he said.
The plant is operated and majority owned by Centerior Energy Corp, while Ohio Edison Co and DQE Inc also have interests in the plant.
